baseline.scope: Read-only source audit; no production or browser execution

risks.title: No durable chat storage
risks.evidence: server.js: const rooms = new Map(); public/index.html uses localStorage
risks.prevention: Add durable storage, migration and restore test before restart

risks.title: Reset/unagree APIs have no authorization
risks.prevention: Require user identity and room membership for all room mutations

risks.title: WebSocket trusts name and room query strings
risks.evidence: server.js: wss.on connection; name/room are query parameters
risks.prevention: Authenticate WS and enforce membership server-side

risks.title: Messages and AI calls unbounded
risks.evidence: server.js: detectAgreement invoked on messages after third
risks.prevention: Set per-user rate, size, concurrency and daily spend limits

risks.title: Date hardcoded and ICS time validation missing
risks.prevention: Use current clock, explicit timezone, robust calendar date validation

risks.title: Client-side room names and group state may diverge across users
risks.prevention: Server-issued conversation IDs and verified invitations

risks.title: Main has unsafe dynamic innerHTML rendering
risks.evidence: public/index.html: renderFriends, renderChats, addBubble, groupFriendList; PR #1 draft
risks.prevention: Use textContent and add synthetic XSS regressions before merge

risks.title: Stale WebSocket reconnect on room change
risks.prevention: Guard reconnect with active socket and room and test switches

risks.title: Client deliberately ignores server history
risks.evidence: public/index.html: history handler ignores server history
risks.prevention: Reconcile authoritative message IDs without duplicates

risks.title: No browser integration test or existing CI baseline
risks.prevention: Add read-only CI plus synthetic browser and server tests
